description: Before acting on intelligence from Telegraph, get a second opinion: Takar asks two DIFFERENT miners the same question (any intent), chosen by an open on-chain record of who was right, and compares their answers field by field. verdict 'agree' -> act on 'answer'. 'disagree' -> do not act on either alone; report both and the differing fields. 'insufficient' -> fewer than two usable answers. Takar pays the asks in test USDC; no key or wallet needed. Testnet only.

intent.description: Exact Telegraph intent name, e.g. WEATHER_FORECAST_VERIFY_GENERAL or EVENT_OUTCOME_RESOLUTION_GENERAL.

params.description: The intent's request params, as its schema defines them.

name: second_opinion
